| Segment | % of Total Revenue* | Key Drivers |

> *Why this matters:* AWS remains the most profitable arm—margin > 40%. However, its share of total revenue has been declining as e‑commerce grows faster than cloud. Diversification into media and logistics helps offset margin compression in retail.
